title: Does school lunch equalize? An examination of dietary quality and socioeconomic disparities in Germany

title_zh: 通过模仿学习：一项实验

title_zh: 从本土到全球：外资并购如何重塑职业流动性

abstract: Quantitative easing (QE) introduced during the 2008 financial crisis, has since remained a key monetary policy tool. Our paper studies how QE affects market liquidity using unique data on Swedish government bonds. We find that there is a deterioration in the level of market liquidity from QE. This scarcity effect is nonlinear. Only after QE reaches a certain volume level, it outweighs the improvement in liquidity from boosting market demand. Unlike market prices, which often react to announcements, liquidity does not change when QE is announced. Instead, the liquidity effect occurs in connection with the actual purchases.
abstract_zh: 2008年金融危机期间引入的量化宽松政策（QE）此后一直是重要的货币政策工具。本文利用瑞典政府债券的独特数据，研究量化宽松如何影响市场流动性。我们发现量化宽松会导致市场流动性水平恶化。这种稀缺效应是非线性的：只有当量化宽松达到一定规模后，其对流动性的负面影响才会超过通过提振市场需求带来的改善效应。与通常对政策公告做出反应的市场价格不同，流动性在量化宽松宣布时并未发生变化，而是与实际购买行为相关联时才产生流动性效应。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: The Liquidity of the Government Bond Market—What Impact Does Quantitative Easing Have? Evidence from Sweden
title_zh: 政府债券市场的流动性——量化宽松有何影响？来自瑞典的证据

abstract: We show that carbon pricing and bank credit complement each other in reducing firms' carbon emission intensity. Our identification exploits a reform‐driven carbon price increase in the EU emission trading system (ETS) and administrative microdata, including the Italian credit registry. We find that highly exposed ETS firms increase term‐loan demand, relative to less exposed ETS firms. Such credit channel is associated with larger investment, but not with higher carbon emissions, reducing emission intensity. These effects are significant only among firms undertaking green investments. Moreover, higher credit demand by ETS firms crowds out credit supply to smaller firms in brown sectors.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，碳定价与银行信贷在降低企业碳排放强度方面具有互补作用。我们的识别策略利用了欧盟排放交易体系（ETS）改革驱动的碳价上涨以及包含意大利信贷登记系统的行政微观数据。研究发现，相较于受ETS影响较小的企业，受ETS影响较大的企业增加了定期贷款需求。这种信贷渠道与更大的投资规模相关，但并未导致碳排放增加，反而降低了排放强度。这些效应仅在进行绿色投资的企业中显著。此外，ETS企业信贷需求的增加挤出了对棕色行业中小企业的信贷供给。
journal: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
title: Carbon Pricing, Credit Reallocation, and Real Effects
title_zh: 碳定价、信贷再配置与实际效应

abstract: We examine how parental income and family structure during childhood and adolescence affect adult income, emphasizing the timing of these effects. Using an ordered multinomial probability model with functional covariates, we find that these familial influences are strongest in middle childhood and adolescence. We also uncover a complementary relationship in the effects of income and family structure trajectories during key developmental periods. By flexibly controlling for personal and family characteristics using nonparametric methods, our approach effectively handles high‐dimensional covariates. The results advance the understanding of intergenerational income mobility and highlight the long‐term importance of early‐life familial conditions for adult economic success.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了童年及青少年时期的父母收入与家庭结构如何影响成年后的收入水平，并重点分析了这些影响的时间节点。通过采用含函数协变量的有序多项概率模型，本研究发现这些家庭因素在童年中期及青少年时期的影响最为显著。同时，研究揭示了关键发育阶段中收入与家庭结构轨迹的互补效应。借助非参数方法灵活控制个人及家庭特征，本模型有效处理了高维协变量问题。研究结果深化了对代际收入流动性的理解，并凸显了早期家庭环境对成年后经济成就的长期重要性。
title: The Effects of Parental Income and Family Structure on Intergenerational Mobility: A Trajectories‐Based Approach
title_zh: 基于轨迹方法的父母收入与家庭结构对代际流动的影响

abstract: This paper investigates how kinship and professional networks shaped labour market outcomes in the guild‐based labour market of early modern Genoa. Using a newly constructed dataset of more than 8,000 apprenticeship contracts (1451–1530), I examine the extent to which family and guild connections influenced apprentices' chances of attaining mastership. Using a probabilistic record‐linkage strategy to reconstruct individual career trajectories, I show that apprentices embedded in kinship or guild networks were substantially more likely to become masters. These advantages operated through multiple channels, including shorter apprenticeship contracts and greater flexibility in training careers, and persisted even during periods of economic contraction, suggesting that apprenticeship in Genoa combined formally open access to training with strong informal mechanisms that structured advancement within skilled trades. The findings contribute to debates on the role of guilds and social networks in pre‐industrial labour markets, highlighting how institutions could simultaneously support skill formation and reproduce inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在近代早期热那亚的行会劳动力市场中，亲属关系与职业网络如何塑造劳动力市场结果。利用新构建的包含8000余份学徒契约（1451–1530年）的数据集，我考察了家庭与行会关系对学徒获得师傅资格的影响程度。通过采用概率性记录关联策略重建个体职业轨迹，我发现嵌入亲属或行会网络的学徒成为师傅的可能性显著更高。这些优势通过多种渠道发挥作用，包括更短的学徒契约期限和更灵活的职业培训路径，并且即使在经济收缩时期依然持续存在。这表明热那亚的学徒制度将正式开放的培训准入与塑造技能行业晋升路径的强有力非正式机制相结合。研究结论为关于前工业劳动力市场中行会与社会网络作用的讨论提供了新视角，揭示了制度如何同时支持技能形成并再生产不平等。
title: Networks paving the way: Apprenticeship, guilds, and access to mastership in early modern Genoa
title_zh: 网络铺路：近代早期热那亚的学徒制、行会与匠师资格获取

abstract: In 2018, two compensating‐income variation studies, based on Household, Income and Labour Dynamics in Australia, reported sharply different monetary health values: A$42,000–A$67,000 for a full quality‐adjusted life year (QALY) gain versus A$162,000 for a 0.10 QALY loss (implying A$1.6 million per QALY under linear scaling). We embark on econometric detective work to identify the sources of these discrepancies, carefully aligning samples, cross‐examining methodologies, and uncovering methodological differences that drive the divergent results. Gain–loss framing is the largest margin (consistent with willingness‐to‐accept/willingness‐to‐pay evidence), while estimator choice (instrumental variables versus reduced form) and income equivalization further magnify differences, jointly resulting in the order‐of‐magnitude gaps with implications beyond health.
title: Following the money: an econometric investigation into health valuations
title_zh: 追踪资金流向：健康价值评估的计量经济学研究

abstract: Market integration is critical for food security in developing economies facing socio-political instability. Using weekly price data from ninety-seven Nigerian markets, this study investigates how violent conflict influences price dynamics between market pairs. Results reveal that frequent violent events have limited short-term effects on price transmission, and changes in conflict intensity do not significantly disrupt price adjustments. Markets with stronger trade connections demonstrate greater resilience by leveraging alternative trade routes. These findings highlight the role of market connectivity in maintaining trade efficiency, suggesting that policies that enhance market networks can strengthen resilience and improve food security.
abstract_zh: 市场整合对于面临社会政治动荡的发展中经济体的粮食安全至关重要。本研究利用尼日利亚97个市场的周度价格数据，考察暴力冲突如何影响市场对之间的价格动态。结果显示，频繁的暴力事件对价格传导的短期影响有限，冲突强度的变化并未显著干扰价格调整。贸易联系较强的市场通过利用替代贸易路线展现出更强的韧性。这些发现凸显了市场连通性在维持贸易效率中的作用，表明增强市场网络的政策能够强化韧性并改善粮食安全。
title: Market integration and the impact of violence on trade networks: Evidence from Nigeria
title_zh: 市场整合与暴力对贸易网络的影响：来自尼日利亚的证据

abstract: Much economic analysis derives policy recommendations based on social welfare criteria intended to model policymakers’ preferences. Yet, little is known about policymakers’ normative views suitable for this use. Our behavioural experiment elicits German legislators’ welfare criteria. When resolving preference conflicts across individuals, they place substantially more importance on least-favoured alternatives than on most-favoured alternatives, contrasting with common aggregation mechanisms and the equal weighting inherent in utilitarianism. When resolving preference conflicts within individuals, politicians choose inconsistently with behavioural economists’ most common approach to welfare analysis with time-inconsistent preferences. In distribution, politicians largely support the same welfare criteria as the public.
abstract_zh: 许多经济分析基于社会福利标准推导政策建议，旨在模拟政策制定者的偏好。然而，关于适合此用途的政策制定者规范观点，我们知之甚少。我们的行为实验揭示了德国立法者的福利标准。在解决个体间的偏好冲突时，他们赋予最不利选项的重要性远高于最有利选项，这与常见的聚合机制及功利主义中固有的平等加权形成对比。在解决个体内部的偏好冲突时，政治家的选择与行为经济学家在时间不一致偏好福利分析中最常用的方法不一致。在分配问题上，政治家与公众所支持的福利标准基本一致。
title: Politicians’ Social Welfare Criteria An Experiment With German Legislators
title_zh: 德国立法者政治家的社会福利标准实验

abstract: Despite the increasing importance of multiple priors in various domains of economics, choice-based incentive-compatible multiple-prior elicitation remains an open problem. This paper develops a solution, comprising a preference-based identification of a subject’s probability interval for an event, and a method for eliciting it. The method applies under weak decision-theoretic assumptions, with no need for probabilistic sophistication. To demonstrate its feasibility, we implement it in three incentivized experiments on artificial and natural sources of uncertainty. Intervals elicited by our method are sensitive to the direction and amount of information and are typically consistent with “objective” probabilities where available. We find a predominance of non-degenerate probability intervals, with intervals being wider when there is less information or predictability. The probability intervals elicited with our method are similar to those stated by subjects on aggregate, suggesting that the method can provide behavioural foundations for the use of stated probability-interval techniques in the field.
abstract_zh: 尽管多重先验在经济学各领域的重要性日益凸显，基于选择的激励相容多重先验启发仍是一个未解难题。本文提出一套解决方案，包含基于偏好的个体事件概率区间识别方法及其启发技术。该方法在弱决策理论假设下适用，无需概率精炼性假设。为验证可行性，我们针对人工与自然不确定性来源开展三项激励实验。实验表明：该方法启发的概率区间对信息方向与信息量敏感，且在存在客观概率时通常与之吻合。我们发现非退化概率区间占主导地位，当信息量较少或可预测性较低时区间宽度更大。该方法启发的概率区间与受试者整体陈述的区间相似，表明该技术可为实地研究中陈述概率区间方法提供行为基础。
title: Eliciting Multiple Prior Beliefs
title_zh: 引出多重先验信念

abstract: We document dramatic changes in euro area interbank money markets during the financial and sovereign debt crises: unsecured borrowing declined across the euro area, while secured market haircuts on sovereign bonds increased, and bank borrowing from the European Central Bank rose in southern countries. We construct a quantitative general equilibrium model to assess the macroeconomic impact of these developments and the associated policy response. Our model features heterogeneous banks and sovereign bonds, secured and unsecured money markets, and a central bank. We compare a benchmark policy—the central bank providing collateralized lending to banks at haircuts lower than the market—with an alternative policy that maintains a constant central bank balance sheet. We show that the fall in output, investment, and capital would have been twice as high under the alternative policy.
abstract_zh: 本文记录了欧元区银行间货币市场在金融危机和主权债务危机期间的剧烈变化：欧元区无担保借贷普遍下降，主权债券的担保市场折扣率上升，而南部国家银行从欧洲中央银行的借款增加。我们构建了一个定量一般均衡模型，以评估这些变化及其相关政策应对的宏观经济影响。该模型包含异质性银行与主权债券、有担保与无担保货币市场，以及中央银行。我们将基准政策——中央银行以低于市场的折扣率向银行提供抵押贷款——与维持中央银行资产负债表不变的替代政策进行比较。研究表明，在替代政策下，产出、投资和资本的下降幅度将是基准政策的两倍。
title: Money Markets, Collateral, and Monetary Policy
title_zh: 货币市场、抵押品与货币政策

abstract: This paper studies the long-term effects of technology and know-how transfers on structural transformations. In the 1950s, the Soviet Union supported the construction of the 156 Projects, which were large-scale, capital-intensive industrial clusters in China. These projects included a technology transfer, consisting of state-of-the-art Soviet machinery and equipment, and a know-how transfer, via the training of Chinese engineers, production supervisors, and high-skilled technicians by Soviet experts. We use newly assembled data that follow steel plants for over four decades, and we exploit natural variation in the transfers they eventually received. We find that, while production advantages stemming from Soviet technology faded away if not complemented with training, the know-how transfer had a long-lasting impact on plant performance, stimulated technology upgrade when China was a closed economy, and increased exports to the Western world when China engaged in international trade. The know-how transfer also generated productivity and technology spillovers onto complementary establishments.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了技术与知识转移对结构转型的长期影响。20世纪50年代，苏联援建了156项工程，这些工程是中国境内大规模、资本密集型的工业集群。这些项目包含技术转移（通过提供苏联最先进的机械设备）和知识转移（通过苏联专家培训中国工程师、生产主管及高级技工）。我们利用新汇编的跨越四十余年的钢铁厂数据，并借助这些工厂最终获得转移项目的自然差异进行分析。研究发现：若缺乏配套培训，源自苏联技术的生产优势会逐渐消退；而知识转移对工厂绩效具有持久影响，在中国封闭经济时期推动了技术升级，并在中国融入国际贸易后增加了对西方世界的出口。此外，知识转移还对配套企业产生了生产率与技术溢出效应。

title: Can energy transition strengthen tax revenue mobilization in developing countries? Empirical evidence and policy implications
title_zh: 能源转型能否增强发展中国家的税收动员能力？实证证据与政策启示

abstract: We provide quasi-experimental evidence of the effects of municipal budget rules on the level of local economic activity exploiting the fact that, in 1999, the Italian government imposed a balanced-budget fiscal rule on all municipal governments but in 2001 exempted municipalities below 5,000 inhabitants. Municipalities which remained subject to budget rules increased taxes but also experienced a significant increase in the number of firms and workers. The increase in taxes was largely financed through issuing more building permits, which led to higher urban revenues. To support the claim that building permits is a plausible mechanism which attracts more firms, in the face of higher taxes, we show that the positive impact of budget rules on employment growth and firms’ entry is concentrated in municipalities with no physical constraints to urban planning and development. (JEL D73, H72, R52, R31, R33)
title: The effects of fiscal rules on building permits and economic activity: quasi-experimental evidence
title_zh: 财政规则对建筑许可和经济活动的影响：准实验证据
